function: above_phy: learning (tabular Q-learning) only plans the UAV trajectory; UAV transmit power and IRS reflection coefficients are solved by CVX/Lagrangian dual and SDR (p. 3).
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Excluded as above_phy: the learned element only designs the trajectory of the UAV (the IR), which the instructions list above the PHY. p. 3: "optimization of the UAV’s transmission power and IRS reflection coefficients using Lagrangian dual transformation and semi-definite relaxation (SDR), while the UAV’s trajectory is optimized with a reinforcement learning (RL)-based algorithm". p. 5: power subproblem (P2) "can be effectively solved using CVX tools"; "Following this, RL is employed to optimize the IR’s trajectory." p. 6-7: "we apply the Q-learning algorithm to formulate C" on a 200 x 200 grid, actions are the flight directions {0, 45, ..., 315 degrees, Motionless}. No PHY decision (power, IRS phases) is learned jointly with the trajectory, so the exception of check 4 does not apply, and the aerial-link exception covers learned power or beams, not trajectory. Read literally, check 3 (no learned component performs the PHY function) would also fit; above_phy is chosen because RL is part of the proposed method and acts on the UAV trajectory.
